    ⭐ Testimonials, reviews and NPS for Rails: in-app collection widget (text + video), public collection page, triage dashboard, read API. Alternative to Testimonial.to / Senja — inside your Rails app.

Hi, I'm Yaro 👋

I build with Ruby on Rails and Hotwire, and teach it on SupeRails.

💎 Drop-in Rails engines

Each one is a gem that runs inside your own app, on your own database, with your own users and auth: no extra SaaS.

Gem What it does Replaces
💬 livechat Support chat widget + team inbox Crisp, Intercom, Chatwoot
💡 ideasbugs In-app product feedback + triage dashboard Canny
⭐ testimonials Testimonials, reviews and NPS: text + video collection, public page Testimonial.to, Senja
🧭 product_tours Product tours and video tutorials, linked into walkthroughs Userpilot, Appcues
📜 agreements Records who accepted which version of your Terms, Privacy Notice or DPA; asks again when they change —
🌍 i18n_proofreading Click any translated string in your running app and suggest better wording —

🛠 More for Rails

  • 🚀 moneygun: Rails 8 multi-tenant SaaS starter (organizations, memberships, subscriptions, SSO)
  • 📱 hotwire_native_rails: generator that sets up a Rails app for Hotwire Native iOS and Android
  • 🍳 hotwire-cookbook: Turbo and Stimulus recipes from my Rails World talk, one pull request per recipe
  • 🔒 active_storage_authorization: default-deny file serving for Active Storage; records decide who may download their files
  • ✈️ noticed-telegram: Telegram delivery methods for Noticed (deliver_by :telegram and bulk_deliver_by :telegram)
  • 💳 pay-whop: Whop payments for the Pay gem (alpha)
  • 🔑 omniauth-whop: Sign in with Whop, an OmniAuth strategy with PKCE and verified OpenID Connect tokens
